panels.title: Mode
panels.description: Paper: the program trades against its own copy of the books; no order leaves the process (exec.live false) · Live: orders go to Bitget · every panel shows the picked mode only, paper and live never merged.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN ('$mode' = 'Live') THEN 'Live Mode · Orders Go to Bitget' ELSE 'Paper Mode · No Orders Leave the Process' END AS "Mode"

panels.title: Process · Newest Sample
panels.description:
The newest sample of the picked mode (the last two days), whatever the time range.

- **Process**: Up and for how long since the run started (green) · Starting: a new run not sampling yet · Stopped: the run stopped in order · Lost (red): no sample for more than 10 s and no stop recorded (a crash, or the process hung) · No Run.
- **Sample Age**: Seconds since the newest per-second sample (signal_sample); red past 10 s.
- **Phase**: Off-Hours: entries allowed · Regular: US regular hours, exits only · Close Window: before the close, forced exits (amber).
- **Anchor**: NAV: both legs on the issuer's NAV · Bell: on F × Binance's index at the close (grey, provisional) · Missing: no anchor, no trading (amber).
- **Mean · σ**: Ready: the mean and sigma have their full windows · Warmup: not yet, no entries (amber).
- **Close At**: The regular close that ends the session, UTC+8: the flatten deadline.
- **Close In**: Time to that close.

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM trade.process_run WHERE live = ('$mode' = 'Live') ORDER BY started_ms DESC LIMIT 1),
     s AS (SELECT * FROM trade.signal_sample WHERE live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND ts_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 172800000 ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1),
     i AS (SELECT * FROM trade.inventory_sample WHERE live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND ts_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 172800000 ORDER BY ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1), h AS (SELECT sum(l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) AS q_bull,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bull * (l.entry_qty_bull - l.exit_qty_bull) / l.entry_qty_bull END) AS v_bull,
             sum(l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) AS q_bear,
             sum(CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bear > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bear * (l.entry_qty_bear - l.exit_qty_bear) / l.entry_qty_bear END) AS v_bear,
             max(c.direction) AS dir
      FROM trade.cycle c JOIN trade.lot l ON l.live = c.live AND l.cycle_id = c.cycle_id
      WHERE c.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND c.status = 'open' AND l.status IN ('building', 'open'))
SELECT CASE WHEN r.run_id IS NULL THEN 'No Run' WHEN r.stopped_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'Stopped'
            WHEN s.run_id IS DISTINCT FROM r.run_id AND (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms < 60000 THEN 'Starting'
            WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL OR (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms > 10 * 1000 THEN 'Lost'
            ELSE 'Up ' || CASE WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 1000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 's' WHEN ((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE (((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad(((((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END END AS "Process",
       round(((extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - s.ts_ms) / 1000.0) AS "Sample Age",
       CASE s.phase WHEN 'off_hours' THEN 'Off‑Hours' WHEN 'regular' THEN 'Regular' WHEN 'close_window' THEN 'Close Window' ELSE s.phase END AS "Phase",
       CASE WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.anchor_kind = 'nav' THEN 'NAV' WHEN s.anchor_kind = 'bell' THEN 'Bell' ELSE 'Missing' END AS "Anchor",
       CASE WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.stats_ready THEN 'Ready' ELSE 'Warmup' END AS "Mean · σ",
       to_char(to_timestamp((s.session_end_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') AS "Close At",
       CASE WHEN s.session_end_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint THEN CASE WHEN (s.session_end_ms - (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (s.session_end_ms - (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)::bigint < 60000 THEN ((s.session_end_ms - (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN (s.session_end_ms - (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)::bigint < 3600000 THEN ((s.session_end_ms - (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)::bigint / 60000) || 'm ' || lpad((((s.session_end_ms - (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)::bigint / 1000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 's' WHEN (s.session_end_ms - (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)::bigint < 86400000 THEN ((s.session_end_ms - (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad((((s.session_end_ms - (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE ((s.session_end_ms - (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad((((s.session_end_ms - (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END WHEN s.session_end_ms IS NOT NULL THEN 'Passed' END AS "Close In",
       CASE WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.idle_reason IS NULL THEN 'Order Sent' ELSE initcap(replace(s.idle_reason, '_', ' ')) END AS "Entry",
       CASE WHEN s.ts_ms IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN s.direction IS NULL THEN 'Flat' ELSE initcap(s.direction) END AS "Position",
       s.hold_bull AS "Bull Held", s.hold_bear AS "Bear Held", (floor((CASE WHEN h.dir IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE h.dir WHEN 'short' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * (s.mid_bull * h.q_bull - h.v_bull + s.mid_bear * h.q_bear - h.v_bear) END)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Unrealised",
       (SELECT sum(c.net) FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND c.session_id = s.session_id AND c.status <> 'open' AND c.funding_known)
         AS "Session Net",
       CASE WHEN i.ts_ms IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN i.mismatch THEN 'Mismatch' ELSE 'None' END AS "Mismatch"
FROM (SELECT 1) one LEFT JOIN r ON true LEFT JOIN s ON true LEFT JOIN i ON true LEFT JOIN h ON true

panels.title: Trading · Newest Sample · USDT
panels.description:
The same newest sample: what the program would do, what it holds and what it made this session.

- **Entry**: Order Sent: an order went out that second · else why none did, the program's idle reason in words: No Signal, Spacing, Regular Hours… · amber: a book, F, orders or quota hold entries back · red: a person is needed (position mismatch, store error, settings, not ready, order unknown).
- **Position**: Flat, or the open cycle's direction: Long (both legs bought, blue), Short (both sold, orange).
- **${bull} Held**: Contracts held on the leg, as the program counts them.
- **Unrealised**: USDT, the open cycle's lots at the newest second's mids against their entry cost, before exit fees (Positions Now has it per leg); – when flat.
- **Session Net**: USDT, the net of the cycles of the newest sample's session that closed, Pending ones left out.
- **Mismatch**: None · Mismatch (red): the venue's positions and the ledger differ; no orders until a person checks.

panels.title: Alerts · Warnings and Errors · Time Range
panels.description:
Every warning and error a module of the program recorded (trade.event) in the time range, newest first

Level: Warn (handled or retried) · Error (a person is needed) · Module: cex, strategy, inventory, exec, store · Kind and Message: what happened · Detail: its numbers (JSON) · at most 200 rows.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT to_timestamp(e.ts_ms / 1000.0) AS "Time", initcap(e.level) AS "Level", e.module AS "Module", e.kind AS "Kind", e.message AS "Message",
         e.detail::text AS "Detail"
  FROM trade.event e
  WHERE e.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND e.level IN ('warn', 'error') AND e.ts_ms >= $__from AND e.ts_ms <= $__to
  ORDER BY e.ts_ms DESC, e.seq DESC LIMIT 200) a
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'No warning or error in the time range', NULL
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.event e WHERE e.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND e.level IN ('warn', 'error') AND e.ts_ms >= $__from AND e.ts_ms <= $__to)

panels.title: Live Execution · D · d_in ${d_in} σ · d_out ${d_out} σ (Newest Run)
Spread · D
panels.description:
Spread = 10⁴ × (F × (P_bull ÷ A_bull + P_bear ÷ A_bear) − 2) on both legs' mids · 1 D = 0.5 bps of the two legs' total notional · Buy Both, Sell Both = Mean + x, the spread at the prices buying, selling both legs fills at (each leg's pricing level) · a Long enters at Buy Both ≤ Mean − d_in σ and exits at Sell Both ≥ Mean − d_out σ · a Short enters at Sell Both ≥ Mean + d_in σ and exits at Buy Both ≤ Mean + d_out σ

The program's own per-second samples (signal_sample) of the picked mode · dashed: entry lines (blue Long, orange Short), dotted: exit lines (orange: a Long's, reached by Sell Both; blue: a Short's, reached by Buy Both), each sample on the d_in, d_out of the run that wrote it · dots, at the instant of the decision: Long Entry (blue, large), Short Entry (orange, large), and not in the legend: Long Exit and Short Exit (the cycle's colour, smaller), Forced Exit (amber), Trim and Complete (grey, small), Void Entry (grey: an entry that filled one leg or none) · shaded: each cycle from its entry to its exit, blue Long, orange Short (its marker under the chart: times, end reason, lots, net) · purple marks under the chart: a change of the anchors in use, with its reason and both legs' anchors before → after in USD and USDT (owner item 62) · tooltip at a dot's instant: the action, both legs' filled contracts and average prices, the notional and fees of its orders (fees as a cost), its cycle's net (Open, Pending) · points: every second up to 25 min, then 5 s (to about 2 h), 10 s (4 h), 30 s (12 h), whole minutes; Buy Both is a bucket's lowest, Sell Both its highest, the rest its last second · a gap: no sample (process down), or a new session or run.

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT (SELECT CASE WHEN r <= 1000 THEN 1000 WHEN r <= 5000 THEN 5000 WHEN r <= 10000 THEN 10000 WHEN r <= 30000 THEN 30000 ELSE ceil(r / 60000) * 60000 END::bigint FROM (SELECT ($__to - $__from) / 1500.0 AS r) x) AS step),
b AS (
  SELECT max(s.ts_ms) AS ts, s.run_id, s.session_id,
         (array_agg(s.mid_d ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC))[1] AS mid, (array_agg(s.mu_d ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC))[1] AS mu,
         (array_agg(s.sigma_d ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC))[1] AS sigma, min(s.x_long_d) AS xl, max(s.x_short_d) AS xs,
         (array_agg(s.anchor_kind IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC))[1] AS anchored, (array_agg(s.idle_reason ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC))[1] AS idle,
         (array_agg(s.direction ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC))[1] AS dir
  FROM trade.signal_sample s CROSS JOIN x
  WHERE s.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND s.ts_ms >= $__from AND s.ts_ms <= $__to
  GROUP BY s.ts_ms / x.step, s.run_id, s.session_id),
k AS (
  SELECT b.*, (r.config -> 'strategy' ->> 'd_in')::float8 AS d_in, (r.config -> 'strategy' ->> 'd_out')::float8 AS d_out,
         lead(b.ts) OVER w AS next_ts, lead(b.run_id) OVER w AS next_run, lead(b.session_id) OVER w AS next_session
  FROM b LEFT JOIN trade.process_run r ON r.run_id = b.run_id AND r.live = ('$mode' = 'Live')
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY b.ts)),
m0 AS (
  SELECT d.ts_ms, d.run_id, d.kind, d.direction, (d.detail ->> 'x_d')::float8 AS x, (d.detail ->> 'mu_d')::float8 AS dmu,
         CASE WHEN d.kind = 'entry' AND l.status = 'void' THEN 8 WHEN d.kind = 'entry' THEN CASE d.direction WHEN 'short' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
              WHEN d.kind = 'exit' THEN CASE d.direction WHEN 'short' THEN 4 ELSE 3 END WHEN d.kind = 'forced' THEN 5 WHEN d.kind = 'trim' THEN 6
              ELSE 7 END AS action,
         CASE WHEN c.status = 'open' THEN -9200000000 WHEN NOT c.funding_known THEN -9000000000 ELSE c.net END AS cycle_net,
         coalesce(d.detail -> 'client_order_ids', jsonb_build_array(d.detail ->> 'client_order_id')) AS ids
  FROM trade.decision d
  LEFT JOIN trade.lot l ON l.live = d.live AND l.lot_id = d.lot_id
  LEFT JOIN trade.cycle c ON c.live = d.live AND c.cycle_id = d.cycle_id
  WHERE d.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND d.kind IN ('entry', 'exit', 'complete', 'trim', 'forced') AND d.ts_ms >= $__from AND d.ts_ms <= $__to),
m AS (
  SELECT m0.ts_ms, m0.run_id, m0.action, m0.cycle_net, coalesce(m0.dmu + m0.x, n.mid_d) AS y, coalesce(m0.x, n.mid_d - n.mu_d) AS dev, o.*
  FROM m0
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.mid_d, s.mu_d FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND s.ts_ms <= m0.ts_ms AND s.ts_ms > m0.ts_ms - 60000
                     ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1) n ON m0.x IS NULL
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT sum(o.cum_exec_qty) FILTER (WHERE o.leg = 'bull') AS q_bull, sum(o.cum_exec_value) FILTER (WHERE o.leg = 'bull') AS v_bull,
           sum(o.cum_exec_qty) FILTER (WHERE o.leg = 'bear') AS q_bear, sum(o.cum_exec_value) FILTER (WHERE o.leg = 'bear') AS v_bear,
           sum(o.fee) AS fee, bool_or(o.cum_exec_qty > 0 AND NOT o.fee_known) AS fee_pending
    FROM trade.cex_order o WHERE o.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND o.client_order_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(m0.ids))) o),
mm AS (SELECT m.*, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY m.ts_ms) AS n FROM m),
u AS (
  SELECT k.ts, false AS mark, NULL::bigint AS n, k.run_id AS run, k.mid, k.mu, k.sigma, k.xl, k.xs, k.d_in, k.d_out, k.anchored, k.idle, k.dir FROM k
  UNION ALL
  SELECT mm.ts_ms, true, mm.n, mm.run_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM mm),
g AS (SELECT u.ts, u.mark, u.n, CASE WHEN u.run IS DISTINCT FROM u.brun THEN NULL ELSE max(u.mid) OVER v END AS mid, CASE WHEN u.run IS DISTINCT FROM u.brun THEN NULL ELSE max(u.mu) OVER v END AS mu, CASE WHEN u.run IS DISTINCT FROM u.brun THEN NULL ELSE max(u.sigma) OVER v END AS sigma, CASE WHEN u.run IS DISTINCT FROM u.brun THEN NULL ELSE max(u.xl) OVER v END AS xl, CASE WHEN u.run IS DISTINCT FROM u.brun THEN NULL ELSE max(u.xs) OVER v END AS xs, CASE WHEN u.run IS DISTINCT FROM u.brun THEN NULL ELSE max(u.d_in) OVER v END AS d_in, CASE WHEN u.run IS DISTINCT FROM u.brun THEN NULL ELSE max(u.d_out) OVER v END AS d_out, CASE WHEN u.run IS DISTINCT FROM u.brun THEN NULL ELSE bool_or(u.anchored) OVER v END AS anchored, CASE WHEN u.run IS DISTINCT FROM u.brun THEN NULL ELSE max(u.idle) OVER v END AS idle, CASE WHEN u.run IS DISTINCT FROM u.brun THEN NULL ELSE max(u.dir) OVER v END AS dir, max(u.n) OVER (ORDER BY u.ts, u.mark ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS pn
      FROM (SELECT u.*, max(u.run) FILTER (WHERE NOT u.mark) OVER v AS brun FROM
              (SELECT u.*, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT u.mark) OVER (ORDER BY u.ts, u.mark) AS grp FROM u) u
            WINDOW v AS (PARTITION BY u.grp)) u
      WINDOW v AS (PARTITION BY u.grp)),
h AS (SELECT g.*, CASE WHEN g.mark THEN g.n
                       WHEN a.ts_ms IS NOT NULL AND g.ts - a.ts_ms <= greatest(x.step, ($__to - $__from) / 150) AND (b.ts_ms IS NULL OR g.ts - a.ts_ms <= b.ts_ms - g.ts) THEN a.n
                       WHEN b.ts_ms IS NOT NULL AND b.ts_ms - g.ts <= greatest(x.step, ($__to - $__from) / 150) THEN b.n END AS cn
      FROM g CROSS JOIN x LEFT JOIN mm a ON a.n = g.pn LEFT JOIN mm b ON b.n = coalesce(g.pn, 0) + 1)

panels.title: Results · USDT
panels.description:
The cycles closed in the scope picked (Summary Scope).

- **Net**: Gross + Fees + Funding of the cycles closed in the scope whose funding is known (Pending ones left out of every money figure).
- **Gross**: Realised before fees, at the fill prices, void entries included.
- **Fees**: Trading fees paid, as a cost (negative).
- **Funding**: Funding booked to those cycles; + received.
- **Return**: Net ÷ the ledger's capital M, in %.
- **Notional**: USDT both legs' orders of every cycle closed in the scope traded, entries and exits.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.* FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND c.status <> 'open' AND c.closed_ms >= CASE '$scope' WHEN 'run' THEN coalesce((SELECT r.started_ms FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') ORDER BY r.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1), 0) WHEN 'session' THEN 0 ELSE $__from END AND c.closed_ms <= CASE '$scope' WHEN 'range' THEN $__to ELSE (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint END AND ('$scope' <> 'session' OR c.session_id = (SELECT s.session_id FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND s.ts_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 172800000 ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1))),
k AS (SELECT * FROM c WHERE c.funding_known AND c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill'),
l AS (SELECT l.* FROM trade.lot l JOIN c ON c.cycle_id = l.cycle_id WHERE l.live = ('$mode' = 'Live')),
st AS (SELECT capital FROM trade.inventory_state WHERE live = ('$mode' = 'Live'))
SELECT (SELECT sum(k.net) FROM k) AS "Net", (SELECT sum(k.gross) FROM k) AS "Gross", (SELECT -sum(k.fees) FROM k) AS "Fees",
       (SELECT sum(k.funding) FROM k) AS "Funding",
       (SELECT 100 * sum(k.net) / nullif((SELECT capital FROM st), 0) FROM k) AS "Return",
       (SELECT sum(o.cum_exec_value) FROM trade.cex_order o JOIN c ON c.cycle_id = o.cycle_id WHERE o.live = ('$mode' = 'Live')) AS "Notional",
       (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill') FROM c) AS "Cycles",
       (SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE k.net > 0) / nullif(count(*), 0) FROM k) AS "Win Rate",
       (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status <> 'void') FROM l) AS "Lots",
       (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'void') FROM l) AS "Void",
       (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT c.funding_known) FROM c) AS "Pending"

SELECT to_timestamp(i.ts_ms / 1000.0) AS time, i.quota_used AS "Quota Used", i.quota_total AS "Quota Total"
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (i.ts_ms / greatest(1, ($__to - $__from) / 1500)) i.*
      FROM trade.inventory_sample i
      WHERE i.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND i.ts_ms >= $__from AND i.ts_ms <= $__to 
      ORDER BY i.ts_ms / greatest(1, ($__to - $__from) / 1500), i.ts_ms DESC) i
ORDER BY i.ts_ms

panels.title: Newest Settlement · Bps
panels.description:
- **Settled At**: The newest settlement the program read, UTC+8, whatever the range.
- **${bull} Rate**: Rate × 10⁴ as Bitget publishes it, signed: + longs pay shorts.
- **Next Settlement**: The newest settlement plus the newest interval between two (8 h so far), UTC+8.

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (SELECT f.settlement_ms, max(f.rate) FILTER (WHERE f.leg = 'bull') AS bull, max(f.rate) FILTER (WHERE f.leg = 'bear') AS bear FROM trade.funding_rate f WHERE f.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') GROUP BY f.settlement_ms), n AS (SELECT * FROM f ORDER BY f.settlement_ms DESC LIMIT 2)
SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((x.t) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') AS "Settled At", (floor((10000 * f.bull)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bull Rate", (floor((10000 * f.bear)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bear Rate",
       CASE WHEN x.gap > 0 THEN to_char(to_timestamp((x.t + x.gap) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') END AS "Next Settlement"
FROM (SELECT max(n.settlement_ms) AS t, max(n.settlement_ms) - min(n.settlement_ms) AS gap FROM n) x
LEFT JOIN f ON f.settlement_ms = x.t

panels.title: Settled Funding Rate · Bps per Settlement
panels.description:
Rate × 10⁴ of each settlement of the two contracts in the range (every 8 h so far), as Bitget publishes it, signed

A positive rate: longs pay shorts · public data, the same in paper and live · bps of the position's value per settlement, not D.

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (SELECT f.settlement_ms, max(f.rate) FILTER (WHERE f.leg = 'bull') AS bull, max(f.rate) FILTER (WHERE f.leg = 'bear') AS bear FROM trade.funding_rate f WHERE f.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') GROUP BY f.settlement_ms)
SELECT to_timestamp(f.settlement_ms / 1000.0) AS time, (floor((10000 * f.bull)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bull Rate", (floor((10000 * f.bear)::float8 * 1e2::float8 + 0.5) / 1e2::float8) AS "Bear Rate"
FROM f WHERE f.settlement_ms >= $__from AND f.settlement_ms <= $__to
ORDER BY f.settlement_ms

defaults.noValue: No settlement in the time range (the newest is above)

panels.title: Funding Booked and Awaited · USDT
panels.description:
Each funding record of the two contracts settled in the range, booked to the cycle whose interval holds the settlement, and each settlement a finished cycle still waits for

Amount: as the venue reports it, + received · Awaited (amber): the cycle's Funding and Net stay Pending until it arrives · Record Time: the record's own time · Type: the venue's record type.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT to_timestamp(f.settlement_ms / 1000.0) AS "Settlement", f.symbol AS "Contract", 'Booked' AS "Status", f.amount AS "Amount",
         f.cycle_id AS "Cycle", to_timestamp(f.ts_ms / 1000.0) AS "Record Time", f.type AS "Type"
  FROM trade.funding f WHERE f.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND f.settlement_ms >= $__from AND f.settlement_ms <= $__to
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_timestamp((a ->> 'settlement_ms')::bigint / 1000.0), CASE a ->> 'leg' WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END, 'Awaited', NULL,
         c.cycle_id, NULL, 'its record has not arrived: the cycle''s Funding and Net are Pending'
  FROM trade.cycle c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(c.funding_awaited) a
  WHERE c.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array') t
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 'None in the range, none awaited'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.funding f WHERE f.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND f.settlement_ms >= $__from AND f.settlement_ms <= $__to)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND jsonb_typeof(c.funding_awaited) = 'array'
                  AND jsonb_array_length(c.funding_awaited) > 0)
ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Cycles · Newest First
panels.description:
Net = Gross + Fees + Funding · a click on Opened shows the cycle in Cycle Detail

Every cycle open at any time in the range, newest first, at most 500 · Held: open to close (to now while open) · Lots: entry batches that filled · Void: voided ones · Notional: USDT both legs' orders traded · Fees as a cost · Funding, Net: Pending (amber) while a settlement it held through has no record; while open, so far · Dust: contracts left on ${bull} / ${bear} too small for an order · Pair Anchors: the anchors (kind, USD per share) that size all its lots · no-fill cycles (neither leg filled) only with No-Fill Cycles = Shown.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.cycle_id, to_timestamp(c.opened_ms / 1000.0) AS "Opened", to_timestamp(c.closed_ms / 1000.0) AS "Closed",
       CASE WHEN (coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN ((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN (coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN ((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm ' || lpad((((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 1000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 's' WHEN (coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN ((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad((((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE ((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad((((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END AS "Held", initcap(c.direction) AS "Direction", initcap(c.status) AS "Status",
       coalesce(initcap(replace(c.end_reason, '_', ' ')), 'Open') AS "End Reason", l.lots AS "Lots", l.void AS "Void", o.notional AS "Notional",
       c.gross AS "Gross", -c.fees AS "Fees", CASE WHEN c.funding_known THEN c.funding ELSE -9000000000 END AS "Funding",
       CASE WHEN c.funding_known THEN c.net ELSE -9000000000 END AS "Net",
       CASE WHEN c.dust_bull <> 0 OR c.dust_bear <> 0 THEN trim_scale(c.dust_bull) || ' / ' || trim_scale(c.dust_bear) END AS "Dust",
       CASE c.pair_anchor_kind WHEN 'nav' THEN 'NAV' ELSE initcap(c.pair_anchor_kind) END || ' ' || trim_scale(round(c.pair_anchor_bull, 4)) || ' / '
         || trim_scale(round(c.pair_anchor_bear, 4)) AS "Pair Anchors"
FROM trade.cycle c
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status <> 'void') AS lots, count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status = 'void') AS void
                    FROM trade.lot x WHERE x.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND x.cycle_id = c.cycle_id) l
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.cum_exec_value) AS notional FROM trade.cex_order x WHERE x.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND x.cycle_id = c.cycle_id) o
WHERE c.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND c.opened_ms <= $__to AND coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) >= $__from AND ('$nofill' = 'Show' OR c.end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'no_fill')
ORDER BY c.opened_ms DESC LIMIT 500

value.title: Show this cycle in Cycle Detail

panels.title: Cycle · USDT
panels.description:
The cycle picked (Cycle, or a click in the Cycles table).

- **Direction**: Long: both legs bought · Short: both sold.
- **Status**: Open, Closed, or Takeover (a person took the positions over).
- **End Reason**: Exit Line, Close Window, Stop, Session Changed, No Fill, One Leg, Store Error; Open while open.
- **Opened**: UTC+8.
- **Held**: Open to close, to now while open.
- **Lots**: Entry batches that filled.
- **Fees**: As a cost.
- **Funding**: Pending while a settlement has no record.
- **Net**: Gross + Fees + Funding; so far while open.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(c.direction) AS "Direction", initcap(c.status) AS "Status", coalesce(initcap(replace(c.end_reason, '_', ' ')), 'Open') AS "End Reason",
       to_char(to_timestamp((c.opened_ms) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI') AS "Opened", CASE WHEN (coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN (coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint < 60000 THEN ((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 1000) || 's' WHEN (coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint < 3600000 THEN ((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 60000) || 'm ' || lpad((((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 1000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 's' WHEN (coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN ((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad((((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE ((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad((((coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - c.opened_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END AS "Held", (SELECT count(*) FROM trade.lot l WHERE l.live = c.live AND l.cycle_id = c.cycle_id AND l.status <> 'void') AS "Lots",
       c.gross AS "Gross", -c.fees AS "Fees", CASE WHEN c.funding_known THEN c.funding ELSE -9000000000 END AS "Funding",
       CASE WHEN c.funding_known THEN c.net ELSE -9000000000 END AS "Net"
FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND c.cycle_id = '$cycle'

panels.title: Lots · ct, USDT and D
panels.description:
Net = Gross + Fees · In / Out Price = traded value ÷ contracts

Each entry batch of the cycle · x, μ, σ: the executable deviation, mean and sigma at its entry decision, D · Fee D: the round-trip fee at its planned prices, D · In: filled on entry and completion · Out: closed by trims and exits, first in first out (an exit across two lots split by quantity) · Void Reason: No Fill, One Leg, Store Error.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.seq AS "Lot", initcap(l.status) AS "Status", initcap(replace(l.void_reason, '_', ' ')) AS "Void Reason", to_timestamp(l.opened_ms / 1000.0) AS "Opened",
       to_timestamp(l.closed_ms / 1000.0) AS "Closed", l.x_d AS "x", l.mu_d AS "μ", l.sigma_d AS "σ", l.fee_d AS "Fee D",
       l.entry_qty_bull AS "Bull In", CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bull / l.entry_qty_bull END AS "Bull In Price", l.entry_qty_bear AS "Bear In", CASE WHEN l.entry_qty_bear > 0 THEN l.entry_value_bear / l.entry_qty_bear END AS "Bear In Price",
       l.exit_qty_bull AS "Bull Out", CASE WHEN l.exit_qty_bull > 0 THEN l.exit_value_bull / l.exit_qty_bull END AS "Bull Out Price", l.exit_qty_bear AS "Bear Out", CASE WHEN l.exit_qty_bear > 0 THEN l.exit_value_bear / l.exit_qty_bear END AS "Bear Out Price",
       l.gross AS "Gross", -l.fees AS "Fees", l.net AS "Net"
FROM trade.lot l WHERE l.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND l.cycle_id = '$cycle' ORDER BY l.seq

panels.title: Orders · ct, USDT and ms
panels.description:
Sent → Ack, Sent → Final: this host's clock · Accepted → Created: Bitget's clock · Fee as a cost

Every order of the cycle as the program knows it, in the order it registered them · Side: Buy or Sell, RO a reduce-only order · Limit, Qty, Filled, Avg Price: the leg's price and contracts · Value: USDT filled · Fee: Pending (amber) while the venue has not reported the fee of what filled (an order without a fill needs none) · Status: Pending, Acked, Filled, Cancelled, Rejected, Not Sent, Never Arrived; · Unknown while queried · Submit → Sent: registered to handed to the venue · Note: cancel reason, error code and message · paper: latencies are the configured simulation.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(o.submitted_ms / 1000.0) AS "Submitted", initcap(o.purpose) AS "Purpose", CASE o.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END AS "Leg",
       initcap(o.side) || CASE WHEN o.reduce_only THEN ' · RO' ELSE '' END AS "Side", o.price AS "Limit", o.qty AS "Qty", o.cum_exec_qty AS "Filled",
       o.avg_price AS "Avg Price", o.cum_exec_value AS "Value", CASE WHEN o.cum_exec_qty > 0 AND NOT o.fee_known THEN -9100000000 ELSE -o.fee END AS "Fee",
       initcap(replace(o.status, '_', ' ')) || CASE WHEN o.unknown THEN ' · Unknown' ELSE '' END AS "Status",
       o.sent_ms - o.submitted_ms AS "Submit → Sent", o.acked_ms - o.sent_ms AS "Sent → Ack", o.final_ms - o.sent_ms AS "Sent → Final",
       o.exchange_created_ms - o.accepted_ms AS "Accepted → Created",
       nullif(concat_ws(' · ', o.cancel_reason, o.error_code, o.error_message), '') AS "Note", o.client_order_id AS "Client Order ID", o.lot_id AS "Lot ID"
FROM trade.cex_order o WHERE o.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND o.cycle_id = '$cycle' ORDER BY o.submitted_ms, o.client_order_id

panels.title: Fills · ct, USDT and ms
panels.description:
Exec → Received = this host's receipt − Bitget's execution time (two clocks)

Each execution of the cycle's orders as the venue reported it · Fee as a cost · Value: price × contracts as reported.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_timestamp(f.exec_ms / 1000.0) AS "Exec Time", CASE o.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END AS "Leg", initcap(o.purpose) AS "Purpose",
       initcap(f.side) AS "Side", f.price AS "Price", f.qty AS "Qty", f.value AS "Value", -f.fee AS "Fee", f.received_ms - f.exec_ms AS "Exec → Received",
       f.client_order_id AS "Client Order ID", f.exec_id AS "Exec ID"
FROM trade.cex_fill f JOIN trade.cex_order o ON o.live = f.live AND o.client_order_id = f.client_order_id
WHERE f.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND o.cycle_id = '$cycle' ORDER BY f.exec_ms, f.exec_id

panels.title: Decisions · D
panels.description:
x = executable spread − Mean at the decision, D

Every decision of the loop for the cycle, oldest first: Entry, Complete, Trim, Exit, Forced (Reason: its cause) · the seconds the spread was at a line but no entry went out (At Line Blocked) folded into one row per reason, with their count and the last time · Detail: the decision's other numbers (prices, contracts, anchors, quota) as the program recorded them · paper_match rows (one per paper order) are in Orders.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT to_timestamp(d.ts_ms / 1000.0) AS "Time", initcap(d.kind) AS "Kind", initcap(d.direction) AS "Direction", d.lot_id AS "Lot",
         (d.detail ->> 'x_d')::float8 AS "x", (d.detail ->> 'mu_d')::float8 AS "μ", (d.detail ->> 'sigma_d')::float8 AS "σ",
         coalesce(d.detail ->> 'cause', d.reason) AS "Reason", 1 AS "Count",
         (SELECT string_agg(k || ' ' || v, ' · ' ORDER BY k) FROM jsonb_each_text(d.detail) e(k, v)
          WHERE k NOT IN ('x_d', 'mu_d', 'sigma_d', 'cause', 'client_order_ids', 'client_order_id', 'depth_seq_bull', 'depth_seq_bear')) AS "Detail"
  FROM trade.decision d WHERE d.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND d.cycle_id = '$cycle' AND d.kind NOT IN ('paper_match', 'at_line_blocked')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT to_timestamp(min(d.ts_ms) / 1000.0), 'At Line Blocked', initcap(max(d.direction)), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, d.reason, count(*),
         'last ' || to_char(to_timestamp((max(d.ts_ms)) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'MM‑DD HH24:MI:SS')
  FROM trade.decision d WHERE d.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND d.cycle_id = '$cycle' AND d.kind = 'at_line_blocked' GROUP BY d.reason) t
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: End Reasons · ${scope:text}
panels.description: Why each cycle closed in the Summary scope ended, how many, and their net (Pending cycles counted, out of Net).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(initcap(replace(c.end_reason, '_', ' ')), 'Open') AS "End Reason", count(*) AS "Cycles", sum(c.net) FILTER (WHERE c.funding_known) AS "Net",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT c.funding_known) AS "Pending"
FROM trade.cycle c WHERE c.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND c.status <> 'open' AND c.closed_ms >= CASE '$scope' WHEN 'run' THEN coalesce((SELECT r.started_ms FROM trade.process_run r WHERE r.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') ORDER BY r.started_ms DESC LIMIT 1), 0) WHEN 'session' THEN 0 ELSE $__from END AND c.closed_ms <= CASE '$scope' WHEN 'range' THEN $__to ELSE (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint END AND ('$scope' <> 'session' OR c.session_id = (SELECT s.session_id FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND s.ts_ms > (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint - 172800000 ORDER BY s.ts_ms DESC LIMIT 1)) GROUP BY c.end_reason ORDER BY count(*) DESC, 1

panels.title: Idle Reasons · Share of Seconds
panels.description: Each second's answer in the time range (signal_sample.idle_reason): Order Sent, or why no order went out, its seconds and share.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(initcap(replace(s.idle_reason, '_', ' ')), 'Order Sent') AS "Reason", count(*) AS "Seconds", 100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER () AS "Share"
FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND s.ts_ms >= $__from AND s.ts_ms <= $__to
GROUP BY s.idle_reason ORDER BY count(*) DESC

panels.title: At Line, Not Entered · Seconds
panels.description: Seconds in the time range the executable deviation was past an entry line but no entry went out (decision at_line_blocked), by reason and side.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(replace(d.reason, '_', ' ')) AS "Reason", initcap(d.direction) AS "Direction", count(*) AS "Seconds", to_timestamp(max(d.ts_ms) / 1000.0) AS "Last"
FROM trade.decision d WHERE d.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND d.kind = 'at_line_blocked' AND d.ts_ms >= $__from AND d.ts_ms <= $__to
GROUP BY d.reason, d.direction ORDER BY count(*) DESC

panels.title: Order Latency by Stage · ms
panels.description: Median, 90th percentile and largest of each stage over the orders submitted in the time range · local: this host's clock; venue: Bitget's · paper: the configured simulated latency, not a measurement.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT k.stage AS "Stage", k.clock AS "Clock", count(k.ms) AS "Orders", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY k.ms) AS "Median",
       percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY k.ms) AS "P90", max(k.ms) AS "Max"
FROM trade.cex_order o
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (0, 'Submit → Sent', 'local', o.sent_ms - o.submitted_ms), (1, 'Sent → Ack', 'local', o.acked_ms - o.sent_ms), (2, 'Sent → Final', 'local', o.final_ms - o.sent_ms), (3, 'Accepted → Created', 'venue', o.exchange_created_ms - o.accepted_ms), (4, 'Created → Last Update', 'venue', o.exchange_updated_ms - o.exchange_created_ms)) k(i, stage, clock, ms)
WHERE o.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND o.submitted_ms >= $__from AND o.submitted_ms <= $__to AND k.ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY k.i, k.stage, k.clock ORDER BY k.i

panels.title: Runs · Time Range

Every start of the program in the picked mode that ran in the range, newest first, and its settings (process_run.config)

r.started_ms)::bigint < 86400000 THEN ((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (SELECT max(s.ts_ms) FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.live = r.live AND s.ts_ms >= r.started_ms), (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) || 'h ' || lpad((((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (SELECT max(s.ts_ms) FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.live = r.live AND s.ts_ms >= r.started_ms), (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 60000) % 60)::text, 2, '0') || 'm' ELSE ((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (SELECT max(s.ts_ms) FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.live = r.live AND s.ts_ms >= r.started_ms), (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 86400000) || 'd ' || lpad((((coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (SELECT max(s.ts_ms) FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.live = r.live AND s.ts_ms >= r.started_ms), (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) - r.started_ms)::bigint / 3600000) % 24)::text, 2, '0') || 'h' END AS "Ran", CASE WHEN r.live THEN 'Live' ELSE 'Paper' END AS "Mode", r.host AS "Host",
       r.config -> 'strategy' ->> 'd_in' AS "d_in", r.config -> 'strategy' ->> 'd_out' AS "d_out",
       upper(r.config -> 'strategy' ->> 'mean_model') || ' ' || (r.config -> 'strategy' ->> 'mean_minutes') || ' · σ ' || (r.config -> 'strategy' ->> 'sigma_minutes')
         AS "Mean · σ (min)",
       r.config -> 'inventory' ->> 'capital' AS "Capital", r.config -> 'inventory' ->> 'leverage' AS "Leverage",
       r.config -> 'cex' ->> 'order_transport' AS "Transport", r.run_id AS "Run ID"
FROM trade.process_run r
WHERE r.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND r.started_ms <= $__to AND coalesce(r.stopped_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) >= $__from
ORDER BY r.started_ms DESC

targets.rawSql:

list.rawQuery:
SELECT c.opened_ms AS time, coalesce(c.closed_ms, (extract(epoch FROM now()) * 1000)::bigint) AS time_end,

       || (SELECT count(*) FROM trade.lot l WHERE l.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND l.cycle_id = c.cycle_id AND l.status <> 'void') || ' lots · Net '

list.name: Anchor Changes
list.rawQuery:
SELECT x.ts_ms AS time, 'Anchor change · ' || CASE WHEN x.anchor_kind IS NULL THEN 'no anchor (Missing): no entries until one is read' WHEN x.ps IS DISTINCT FROM x.session_id THEN 'new session ' || x.session_id || ' (the close)
bell anchor (F × Binance''s index at the close; the NAV to follow)' WHEN x.pk IS NULL THEN 'an anchor read again' WHEN x.pk = 'bell' AND x.anchor_kind = 'nav' THEN 'NAV confirmed for session ' || x.session_id || '
both legs'' NAV unchanged for 1 h (Direxion' || coalesce(': first seen ' || (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((min(a.known_ms)) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'nav_seen' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) || ', confirmed ' || (SELECT to_char(to_timestamp((max(a.known_ms)) / 1000.0) AT TIME ZONE 'Etc/GMT-8', 'HH24:MI') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'nav' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms), '') || ')' WHEN x.pk = 'nav' AND x.anchor_kind = 'bell' THEN 'the bell again: the NAV not yet confirmed in this run' WHEN (SELECT string_agg(CASE a.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END || ' ' || trim_scale(a.value), ', ') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'dividend' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) IS NOT NULL THEN 'a dividend takes effect (anchor − D; read for the session: ' || (SELECT string_agg(CASE a.leg WHEN 'bull' THEN '$bull' ELSE '$bear' END || ' ' || trim_scale(a.value), ', ') FROM trade.anchor_fact a WHERE a.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND a.session_id = x.session_id AND a.kind = 'dividend' AND a.known_ms <= x.ts_ms) || ' USD)' WHEN x.prun IS DISTINCT FROM x.run_id THEN 'the anchor read again' ELSE 'a split, or a corrected reading, of the same kind' END || CASE WHEN x.prun IS DISTINCT FROM x.run_id THEN ' · at a restart of the program' ELSE '' END || '
' || '$bull ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bull, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bull, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USD · ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bull / x.pf, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bull / x.f, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USDT
' || '$bear ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bear, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bear, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USD · ' || coalesce(to_char(x.p_bear / x.pf, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(to_char(x.anchor_bear / x.f, 'FM999,990.00'), '–') || ' USDT
USDT = USD ÷ F, F = ' || CASE WHEN x.pf = x.f THEN x.f::text ELSE coalesce(x.pf::text, '–') || ' → ' || coalesce(x.f::text, '–') END || ' USD/USDT (the program''s)' AS text FROM (SELECT s.ts_ms, s.run_id, s.session_id, s.anchor_kind, s.anchor_bull, s.anchor_bear, s.f, lag(s.ts_ms) OVER w AS pts, lag(s.run_id) OVER w AS prun, lag(s.session_id) OVER w AS ps, lag(s.anchor_kind) OVER w AS pk, lag(s.anchor_bull) OVER w AS p_bull, lag(s.anchor_bear) OVER w AS p_bear, lag(s.f) OVER w AS pf FROM trade.signal_sample s WHERE s.live = ('$mode' = 'Live') AND s.ts_ms >= $__from - 600000 AND s.ts_ms <= $__to WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY s.ts_ms)) x WHERE x.ts_ms >= $__from AND x.pts IS NOT NULL AND (x.anchor_kind, x.anchor_bull, x.anchor_bear) IS DISTINCT FROM (x.pk, x.p_bull, x.p_bear)
